facts.fact: The Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education's compact of December 2022 says the EMIS is a central database of the annual ED46 school census, keyed at national level, and that it still needs to be developed to include individual girls' and boys' data; it lists tracking mechanisms for individual pupils among the gaps and says an electronic record of pupil profiling is needed.
facts.system: EMIS (individual pupil data, not yet included)

systems.country_label: EMIS (Education Management Information System), fed by the ED46 school census form
systems.owner: Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education, Strategy, Policy Planning, Research and Statistics Department
systems.tiers: collected from schools once a year on the ED46 form; entered at national level into a central database and analysed at Head Office; annual statistics report produced at national level only

systems.owner: Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education

6,111 schools targeted for connectivity; none had received computer equipment

note: The one fact is a dated statement of absence: the document describes only a yearly census under the EMIS name and says per-pupil data is still to be added; it does not say how schools keep learner records. Discard if an absence stated this way is not wanted.
